title: DVBS-APSK Demodulator Baseband
text: DVB-S2/S2X/SH standard-specific APSK demodulation, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Decision type} sets Demodulation; {DVB standard suffix} sets the standard suffix S2, {Frame length}, {Modulation order}, {Code identifier}, {Constellation scaling}, {Output type}, {Noise variance source}, {Noise variance}, {Output data type} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: DVB-S2/S2X/SH standard-specific APSK modulated signal scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: Noise variance positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Constellation scaling
params.values: Constellation scaling Outer radius as 1 (default) | Unit average power

params.name: Decision type
params.values: Demodulation decision type Hard decision (default) | Log-likelihood ratio | Approximate log-likelihood ratio

params.name: Noise variance source
params.values: Noise variance source Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Noise variance
params.values: Noise variance 1 (default) | positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
